title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 304
paragraphs: The wives of men of rank, when they die, are not given at once to be embalmed; nor are such women as are very beautiful, or of greater regard than others. Rather, on the third or fourth day after their death — and not before — they are delivered to the embalmers. They do so in this matter so that the embalmers may not abuse their women; for they say that one of them was once caught doing so to the corpse of a woman recently dead, and his fellow-craftsman gave information.
